author: HBO Max
description:
On Episode 10 of the Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast Season 1, Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton celebrate the finale with Chuck Lorre, Zak Penn, Bill Prady, Kevin Sussman, and Lauren Lapkus. The creators and stars give fans behind-the-scenes access to “Spoiler: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience,” including how Stuart and Denise escaped into a Big Bang Theory-style sitcom universe.

This finale conversation covers the comic book multiverse, the rebuilt comic shop set, Lauren and Kevin’s terrifying wire stunt, and the clue suggesting our heroes may not have reached the real world after all.

✅ Chuck Lorre, Zak Penn and Bill Prady explain why the all-powerful adversary trapped Stuart inside a sitcom
✅ The hidden Warner Bros. backlot posters that suggest Stuart and Denise did not escape into our universe
✅ How the crew rebuilt the comic book shop from scratch for a full multi-camera production
✅ Kevin Sussman reveals that SFTSTU’s Apocalypse Stuart is not the original Big
